description: Templat keperluan yang diadaptasi daripada dokumen D.CHQ.QDM Finished Lot Yield Dashboard. Templat ini merangkumi trend yield finished lot, KPI output dan loss, Pareto defect code, interaksi penapis, kontrak data, peraturan pengiraan yield, inventori carta, peraturan UI, spesifikasi teknikal dan kriteria penerimaan. Imej asal digantikan dengan penerangan teks.
applicable_scenarios: Analisis trend yield mingguan / bulanan / suku tahunan
Pareto nisbah loss mengikut defect code dan jabatan punca
Pengesahan formula manufacturing yield dan kontrak data
Dashboard responsif dengan peraturan eksport dan kebenaran

document_info.requirement_name: Dashboard Prestasi Finished Lot dan Nisbah Defect Loss
document_info.author: Ely Yi

background.summary: Dashboard ini menyediakan paparan tahap tinggi untuk metrik yield utama bagi produk berbeza di kilang dan dikemas kini setiap hari melalui skrip berjadual automatik.
background.objective: Mempercepat peningkatan yield, menurunkan kos produksi, meningkatkan output tanpa kos tambahan, dan mendapatkan semula kos pelaburan lebih awal melalui trend, drill-down, Pareto defect code dan atribusi punca.

in_scope: Finished Lot Performance Overview Trend page for finished yield, latest-week Output, Yield, and NSQM Loss.
Loss Ratio By Defect Code page for top 10 to 20 defect loss ratios, defect-code trend, and cause department distribution.
Unified filters: Customer, Plant, Date Type, Lot Type, Unit Type, and Project Type.
Finished Yield calculation logic for lot-level and weekly aggregated product yield.
Chart inventory, data contract, UI states, responsive layout, export permission, and acceptance validation.
out_of_scope: Formal QMS defect disposition workflow replacement.
Self-service BI modeling beyond the approved chart inventory.

core_scenarios: Yield team opens the Finished Lot Performance Overview Trend page to review weekly finished yield and latest-week Output, Yield, and NSQM Loss.
QDM user changes Customer, Plant, Date Type, Lot Type, Unit Type, or Project Type filters and expects affected charts to refresh without a full page reload where feasible.
Engineer clicks a trend segment to switch the detail panel on the right and inspect the selected time range or product segment.
Manager opens Loss Ratio By Defect Code to review top defect loss ratios, defect trends, and cause department distribution.
QA validates displayed values against the approved QDM source tables for default filters and representative filter combinations.

functional_requirements.overview: The example contains two core analytic pages: Finished Lot Performance Overview Trend and Loss Ratio By Defect Code. Both pages share the same filter contract and must support interactive chart selection, readable tooltips, accessible legends, and permission-aware export.

feature_details.description: Display finished yield by selected time range and show latest-week Output, Yield, and NSQM Loss details.
feature_details.trigger: User opens the dashboard or changes the shared filter bar.
feature_details.processing_logic: Load weekly finished-lot summary data from DS-01. The main chart displays finished product yield by week by default; clicking the left chart switches the right-side detail view.

feature_details.description: Display top 10 to 20 defect loss ratios by defect code and show related defect-code trend and cause department detail.
feature_details.trigger: User navigates to the loss-ratio page or clicks a defect-code segment.
feature_details.processing_logic: Load defect summary data from DS-02, rank defect codes by loss ratio, render the main defect-loss chart, and update the right-side trend and department distribution based on selection.
exception_cases: Chart cannot render due to insufficient data

feature_details.description: Provide a shared filter bar and consistent interaction behavior for all applicable charts.
feature_details.trigger: User changes any filter, selects a chart segment, toggles a legend, opens a tooltip, or exports data.
feature_details.processing_logic: Apply filters to all affected charts without full page reload where technically feasible. Active chart segments must be visually indicated and the active filter context must remain visible.
exception_cases: Keyboard focus or touch interaction unavailable

feature_details.feature_name: Finished Yield calculation and data contract
feature_details.description: Define lot-level and weekly product yield calculations and bind all charts to approved QDM tables.
feature_details.trigger: Dashboard refresh or QA data validation.
feature_details.processing_logic: Calculate process yield as Output divided by Input, then multiply sequential process yields. Lot yield is calculated for one batch; weekly yield aggregates the selected week using the approved source query and shipment/finished output basis.

business_rules: Filter defaults are Customer=All selected, Plant=All selected, Date Type=Weekly, Lot Type=HVM, Unit Type=NSQM, Project Type=Overall.
Filter changes shall update all affected charts without requiring a full page reload when technically feasible.
A selected chart segment must visually indicate active state and make the active filter visible to the user.
Tooltips must be readable on desktop and replaced by tap-friendly detail behavior on touch devices where needed.
Interactive chart legends must be keyboard reachable.
Export actions must follow data permission rules and include applied filter context where practical.
Finished Yield is based on the multiplication of Output/Input ratios across key processes.
Data owner must confirm source tables, field definitions, refresh cadence, join logic, and calculation rules before release.

interaction_flow: User opens the dashboard and sees default Weekly / HVM / NSQM / Overall data.
User changes one or more filters; all affected charts refresh and keep the selected context visible.
User clicks a chart segment; the selected segment is highlighted and the right-side detail chart switches to the selected segment.
User hovers or taps a chart data point to inspect tooltip/detail information.
User exports chart data; export follows permission rules and includes applied filter context where practical.

Weekly Finished Lot Performance Overview Trend
data_and_dependencies: DS-01: [QDMProductionDB].[IDA].[Yield_Dashboard_FinishedLotSummaryData_Internal], grain Weekly/Quarterly/Monthly, weekly refresh, owner QDM.
DS-02: [QDMProductionDB].[IDA].[Yield_Dashboard_FinishedLotSummaryDefectData_Internal], grain Weekly/Quarterly/Monthly, weekly refresh, owner QDM.
Required fields from DS-01: ATSDate, DateType, LotType, Project Type, Yield, Output_NSQM.
Required fields from DS-02: DefectCode, DefectQty, Department.
Chart CH-01 Finished Overall Trend: line chart, metric Yield, dimensions Weekly/Quarterly/Monthly, source DS-01, hover tooltip and click-to-filter detail table.
Chart CH-02 Defect Loss Ratio: stacked bar chart, metric Defect Loss Ratio, dimension Top 20, source DS-02, legend toggle and click-to-filter related charts.
Chart CH-03 Detailed chart on the right: table/line/pie, content based on selected left data and current filters, source DS-01 + DS-02, supports pagination, sort, export.
Frontend stack expectation: HTML + Bootstrap + JavaScript/jQuery unless project standard confirms otherwise.
Approved enterprise browser baseline: current Chrome and Edge versions.
risks_and_notes: The final default layout option still needs business confirmation if Primary-Detail / Hero is not accepted.
Final source tables/views/APIs and join keys must be confirmed by the data owner.
The mandatory first-release chart list must be confirmed by the business owner.
Export permissions for chart images or underlying data must be confirmed by security and business owner.
Refresh cadence and SLA for data availability must be confirmed by the data owner.
acceptance_criteria: Business owner confirms chart list, metric definitions, filter list, default view, and layout pattern.
Data owner confirms source tables/views/APIs, field mapping, refresh cadence, join logic, and calculation rules.
All charts render correctly for default filters and at least three representative filter combinations.
Loading, empty, error, active, hover, focus, and disabled states are implemented and visually consistent.
The page is responsive on desktop, tablet, and mobile widths with no clipped text, overlapping controls, or unreadable chart labels.
Export behavior follows approved data permission rules and includes applied filter context where applicable.
QA verifies data accuracy against source queries or an approved reference report.
The final page follows the approved AITC color system and does not introduce unapproved primary colors or heavy decorative styling.
open_questions: Which layout option is the approved default: Primary-Detail / Hero, Uniform Grid, Tabbed, or another pattern?
What are the final source tables/views/APIs and join keys?
Which charts are mandatory for first release and which are optional?
Which roles may export chart images or underlying data?
What is the approved refresh cadence and SLA for data availability?

image_descriptions: Overview page screenshot: a Quality Operation Center page with a shared filter bar at the top, a large Weekly Finished Lot Performance Overview Trend chart on the left, and latest-week Output / Yield / NSQM Loss detail on the right.

Loss-ratio page screenshot: a shared filter bar at the top, a main chart ranking top 10 to 20 defect codes by loss ratio, and a right-side detail area for defect-code trend plus cause department distribution.
Filter screenshot: dropdown filters for Customer, Plant, Date Type, Lot Type, Unit Type, and Project Type with defaults All selected, All selected, Weekly, HVM, NSQM, and Overall.
Lot Product Yield formula image: finished yield for a single batch is calculated by multiplying each key process yield, where each process yield is Output divided by Input.
Weekly Product Yield formula image: weekly product yield is calculated from weekly aggregated shipment/finished output data using the approved QDM source query and the same Output/Input yield logic.
Calculation example image: a process table starts from 50,000 units and multiplies sequential process yields, for example GTY = 99.4% × 99.5% × 99.29% × 99.38% × 99.17% × 99.49% × 99.39%.
non_functional_targets: Displayed values must match approved source query results for the same filters.
Normal filter or chart refresh target is 3 seconds under standard data volume, subject to API performance.
Controls must be keyboard reachable with visible focus state and sufficient contrast.
Failure in one chart must not break the whole page; show chart-level error state.
Layout must remain readable across approved desktop, tablet, and mobile widths.
